description: This source file defines the CreateCVDAction component responsible for orchestrating the creation and launch of CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device) instances, including validation, configuration, and artifact management. It includes struct definitions, constructor, and methods for launching CVDs based on different build sources, particularly focusing on Android CI builds.

classes.name: BuildAPICredentials
classes.description: Struct holding credentials for Build API, including OAuth token and GCP project ID.

classes.name: CreateCVDActionOpts
classes.description: Options for constructing a CreateCVDAction, including request data, validator, paths, managers, and credentials.

classes.name: CreateCVDAction
classes.description: Main struct orchestrating CVD creation, managing state, configuration, and launching processes.

methods.name: NewCreateCVDAction
methods.description: Constructor function initializing a new CreateCVDAction with provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Validates the request and environment, then launches the CVD creation process asynchronously.

methods.name: launchCVD
methods.description: Internal method to execute CVD launch, handling success or error completion.

methods.name: launchWithCanonicalConfig
methods.description: Prepares configuration file and credentials, then loads the CVD group based on configuration.

methods.name: launchCVDResult
methods.description: Handles launching a CVD from the specified build source, returning the created group or error.

methods.name: launchFromAndroidCI
methods.description: Launches CVDs using Android CI build sources, managing artifacts and instance creation.

methods.name: newInstanceNumbers
methods.description: Generates a sequence of unique instance numbers for new CVD instances.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Checks the validity of the CreateCVDRequest, ensuring required fields are present.

methods.name: createTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified data and permissions, used for config files.
